title: Grateful Dead Live at Moscone Convention Center on 1982-05-28

ai_review.summary: Muddled arena recording of a chaotic Vietnam‑Vets benefit show with stellar Boz Scaggs guest jam but an uneven Dead performance.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a bizarre benefit concert where the Dead were not even the headliners. While the second set featuring Boz Scaggs and John Cipollina is praised as a blues‑rock highlight, the overall show suffers from muddied sound, muted vocals and a noticeably sloppy, drug‑induced performance by Jerry and Bob. The recording quality is only fair, making the occasional brilliance hard to fully appreciate.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews are split – some give five‑star enthusiasm for the guest set and overall vibe, but several note poor sound, muted vocals and a sloppy Dead performance; averaging these points yields an above‑average but not great rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as muffled with Jerry's vocals often cut out; likely recorded from the arena crowd in a venue with large pillars, leading to uneven mix and limited clarity.

standout_songs: Second set jams with Boz Scaggs & John Cipollina (blues/rock highlights)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Benefit gig with an odd line‑up – the Dead opened, many left during the Starship set, and the second half revived interest thanks to guest musicians; overall pacing feels disjointed.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals often shut off; described as wasted and barely able to play or sing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Also noted as high/on‑the‑rocks during the performance.
